messages:
Morgan (eng-platform): quick pitch: "rapid-swap" — switch traffic quickly based on a composite health score instead of slow weight ramps. use mirrors + probes to compute score. pros/cons?
June (architecture): interesting. faster recovery but risk of flip-flops. need hysteresis and clear preconditions.
Cam (eng-runtime): runtime constraints: must ensure mirrors are fire-and-forget. also need to estimate cache-warmth delta before swapping. cold caches can blow p99 temporarily.
Noor (eng-sre): safety checklist: 1) fallback target has >= spare capacity 2) token-cost delta within budget 3) health checks green for 30s 4) fallback cooldown of 5m to avoid thrash.
Lin (eng-ml): composite score should include semantic check (mini-eval), latency p99 relative to baseline, and error-rate. weight these by risk profile per-route.
Morgan (eng-platform): propose score formula: 0.5*latency_score + 0.3*error_score + 0.2*semantic_score. threshold > 0.7 triggers swap.
June (architecture): also require audit event with reason, affected-tenants, and correlation id for every auto-swap. developer opt-out flag per-route for experiments.
Cam (eng-runtime): implement swap as routing policy override with TTL + drain window. preserve session affinity: new sessions directed to new variant, old sessions continue until session TTL.
Noor (eng-sre): add rollback probe: after swap, run a lightweight probe against previous variant. if it recovers and is better on composite score for 2 consecutive windows, consider gentle revert.
Lin (eng-ml): for semantic checks use a tiny curated prompt set per-route and embedding drift + task-specific metric (BLEU/NLL/embedding-sim). avoid heavy evals in hot path.
ops-bot: mirror-pipeline: running; probe-agent: online; audit-log: enabled
Morgan (eng-platform): config sketch: \n```\nrapid_swap:\n  mirror: {enabled: true, priority: best-effort}\n  probes: {strata: [short, medium, long], base_rate: 1/min}\n  composite_weights: [0.5,0.3,0.2]\n  trigger_threshold: 0.7\n  preconditions: [capacity_check, cost_check]\n  cooldown: 300s\n  drain_window: 60s\n```\nJune (architecture): runbook notes: auto-swap should notify owners, annotate traces, and open a review ticket automatically if swap lasted > 10m.
Cam (eng-runtime): runtime todo: bounded mirror queue + drop-on-full, correlation header X-Shadow:1, emit cache_coldness_estimate metric.
Noor (eng-sre): SLOs: when swap occurs, alert if fallback target p99 increases > 20% within 2m. otherwise just annotate.
Lin (eng-ml): action: I'll assemble per-route mini-eval sets and baseline profiles by seq_len.
Morgan (eng-platform): action: I'll draft RFC with config semantics and example runbooks. good discussion, thanks all :thumbsup:
